topic: How does the hierarchical classification framework impact satellite link budget margins when prioritizing QoS-sensitive traffic?
consensus_response: The hierarchical classification framework prioritizes QoS-sensitive traffic, optimizing resource allocation and enhancing signal quality. Integrating latency, adaptive modulation, and beamforming improves QoS guarantees. Machine Learning and Software-Defined Networking further optimize link budget margins by predicting traffic patterns and dynamically adjusting resource allocation.
reference_context: QoS-OSPF and DiffServ frameworks have limitations in satellite communications, neglecting high fixed latencies and failing to consider latency metrics in path selection.
